description: The file defines the StudioModule class used in SuiteCRM for module management within the Studio interface. It includes methods for retrieving module metadata, relationships, views, layouts, subpanels, and handling module-specific operations. It interacts with various modules and external classes to facilitate module customization and metadata handling.

classes.name: StudioModule
classes.description: Represents a module within SuiteCRM's Studio interface, providing functionalities to access and manipulate module metadata, views, relationships, subpanels, and layout configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StudioModule with a specified module name, loading metadata, fields, and setting up source definitions.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the formal name of the module, handling special cases for modules with inconsistent naming.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines and returns the type of the module, such as 'basic', 'issue', 'company', etc., based on module characteristics and parent class hierarchy.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the field definitions for the module.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Builds and returns a hierarchical array representing the module's node structure for the interface.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Provides sub-nodes related to module-specific features such as labels, fields, relationships, layouts, and subpanels.

methods.name: getViews
methods.description: Detects and returns available view metadata files for the module, including default and custom definitions.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Provides layout options including standard views, quick-create forms, dashlets, popups, and search filters.

methods.name: isValidDashletModule
methods.description: Checks if the specified module has associated Dashlet files, indicating support for dashlet features.

methods.name: getSearch
methods.description: Builds search layout nodes for basic and advanced searches.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Returns the set of relationships involving this module.

methods.name: getSubpanels
methods.description: Retrieves subpanel configurations for the module.

methods.name: getProvidedSubpanels
methods.description: Lists subpanels provided by this module for other modules.

methods.name: getParentModulesOfSubpanel
methods.description: Finds modules that use a specific subpanel.

methods.name: removeFieldFromLayouts
methods.description: Removes a specified field from all relevant layouts, views, subpanels.

methods.name: getViewMetadataSources
methods.description: Collects and returns sources for various view metadata types.

methods.name: getViewType
methods.description: Determines the view type associated with a name.
